supported_claims: The pack freezes seven dataset manifest hashes and each available lock hash, six source-code hashes, nine base artifacts, and every completed smoke-benchmark candidate report.
Exact replay commands and explicit evidence/clinical limitations are included.
The pack preserves no-download/no-paid-call policy and marks clinical release blocked.
limitations: The pack records an unclean worktree at capture, with 14 outstanding local paths; it hashes a declared artifact set rather than asserting a clean checkout.
Dataset/model outputs are development evidence only; no independent clinical study or real-patient acceptance is included.
